hana brata, kumavaśa, ṅa, pituṅ kulǝm tan kәneṅ turu rahina vәṅi, pha, vīryavan, siddha sakāryanta, tan pamaṅgih kevǝh.

(1266)(1267)(1268)(1269)(1270)(1271)(1272)(1273)
Translation


3.162

hana brata, niṅibu, ṅa, amaṅan sarvaibu, pataṅ lek divaśanya, pha, mulih riṅ ⟨svarga⟩ bhaṭāra rudra, sasarnya majanma riṅ kula, ¿saṅ kumbhakarṇa, aturu tan paṅlihan, rahina vәṅi tur aṅupavāśa, pha, keḍәp saparipolahta.?

Translation


3.163

hana brata, tan pamaṅan tan paturu, saṅ hyaṅ tan kaviśeṣa, hyaṅnya, pha, svarga titisnya.

(1274)(1275)(1276)(1277)(1278)(1279)
Translation


3.164

hana brata, lәvih turu, ṅa, tan trәṣṇeṅ paṅān, bhaṭārī keśava hyaṅiṅ brata, pha, mantuk riṅ svarga bhaṭāra śiva, mañjanma ri kulaputra, luputiṅ lara vighna, subhaga anulus.

(1280)(1281)(1282)
Translation


3.165

hana brata, mopavāsa pituṅ rātri, atәhәr tan kәneṅ turu rahina vәṅi, bhaṭāra śīva hyaṅiṅ brata, ma, om̐ nāma śivāya, pamit, pha, vīryavan , ⟨pha⟩, sakāryanta siddha, tәhәr siddhi.

(1283)
Translation


3.166

hana brata ambīra, ṅa, yan amaṅan mevaka uyah kevala, satahun tigaṅ lek samayanya, bhaṭāra iśvara hyaṅnya, ma, om̐ mam̐ iśvarāya namaḥ pha, siṅ prih meṅgal katәmu, kinasihiṅ rāt kita, mvaṅ deva bhūta sih iri kita.

(1284)(1285)(1286)(1287)(1288)(1289)(1290)(1291)(1292)(1293)
Translation


3.167

hana brata aṅlavar, ṅa, tan pamaṅaniṅ uyahan, satahun divasanya, bhaṭāra śaṅkara hyaṅnya, pha, mulih riṅ kendran, sasarnya majanma riṅ lituhayu prajña kita.

(1294)
Translation


3.168

hana brata, ṅlavar, ṅa, tan pamaṅan uyah, pat vulan pәtaṅ vәṅi samayanya, bhaṭāra śaṅkara hyaṅnya, pha, mantuk mariṅ kendran, sasarnya mañjanma lituhayu paripūrṇa.

(1295)(1296)
Translation


3.169

hana brata, aṅupavāsa, ṅa, lamun amaṅan aṅgugut uyah arәṅ rumuhun, 3, tahun divasanya, bhaṭārī gaṅga hyaṅniṅ brata, ma, om̐ gaṅgāyai nama svāhā, pha, saparipolahta kinerәṅan deniṅ jagat.

(1297)
Translation


3.170

hana brata, maṅan tumpǝṅ mevak uyah harәṅ, bhaṭāra iśvara hyaṅnya, ya pinakarūpa, pinakaśvaraniṅ kiduṅ carita, pha, manisiṅ panutukan.

(1298)(1299)
Translation


3.171

hana brata, amaṅan kǝmbaṅ, naṅkǝn, u, mevak uyah harәṅ, vusiṅ amaṅan, aṅinaṅ suruh pupucuk, aṅliṅga kǝmbaṅ, ṅa, pha, sukha sugih, rūpa aheṅ.

(1300)
Translation


3.172

hana brata, amaṅan tan pauyah, pituṅ vәṅi samayanya, pha, śaktinta ḍatәṅ, tәhәr kinatvaṅan deniṅ hyaṅ.

Translation


3.173

hana brata, amaṅan arasotih, ṅa, aḍahar uyah harәṅ pinakavulam, lama pituṅ dina, ra nini paduka bhaṭārī sarasvatī hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, prajñan.

(1301)(1302)
Translation


3.174

nihan kr̥ta māsa, ṅa, hayuniṅ hulun, akārya hayu, makādi vatǝk abrata, nūt avarah,

(1303)
Translation


§1 śaśih ka, 1, taṅ, piṅ, 10, saṅ hyaṅ vīra kusuma devatanya, bratanya, hayva maṅan sarvabuṅkah, pha, sugih anom drәman avǝvәka ta sira.

Translation


§2 śaśih, 2, taṅ, piṅ, 7, saṅ hyaṅ jaya kusuma devatanya, bratanya hayva maṅan sapi, pha, luputeṅ tuju tәluh tarañjana, drәman ahiven iven.

Translation


§3 śaśih, 3, taṅ, piṅ, 9, saṅ hyaṅ naka devatanya, bratanya, hayva maṅan bavi, pha, tan katampǝkan gәriṅ aguṅ.

Translation


§4 śaśih, 4, taṅ, piṅ, 15, saṅ hyaṅ asmara devatanya, bratanya, hayva maṅan sarvaroṇḍon, pha, dadi siṅ tinandur.

Translation


§5 śaśih, 5, paṅloṅ, piṅ, 15, saṅ hyaṅ mahādeva devatanya, bratanya, hayva sǝhǝk yan aṅucap, hayva ṅǝmban boñcah, pha, drәman avǝvәka.

(1304)
Translation


§6 śaśih, 6, taṅ, piṅ, 8, saṅ hyaṅ atanu devatanya, bratanya, hayva aṅinǝp, riṅ paluluṅhān, pha, sugih tan kelaṅ elaṅan.

Translation


§7 śaśih, 7, taṅ, piṅ, 13, saṅ hyaṅ manasija devatanya, bratanya, aṅraka, pha, sugih keḍәp kapaṅgih siṅ giṇa harṣa.

Translation


§8 śaśih, 8, taṅ, piṅ, 2, saṅ hyaṅ anaṅgara devatanya, bratanya, hayva amaṅan paṭik vǝnaṅ suku pat, pha, sugih patik vǝnaṅ.

Translation


§9 śaśih, 9, taṅ, piṅ, 6, saṅ hyaṅ ravi devatanya, bratanya, hayva maṅan asu, pha, apәkik raspati prajurit.

Translation


§10 śaśih, 10, taṅ, piṅ, 4, saṅ hyaṅ brahmā devatanya, bratanya, hayva maṅan andǝlәṅ riṅ luhur, pha, kinasihaniṅ hyaṅ, mvaṅ voṅ mule akveh asih iri kita.

(1305)
Translation


§11 śaśih, jyeṣṭa, taṅ, piṅ, 5, saṅ hyaṅ leka jaya devatanya, bratanya, aṅlampar ananapu, pha, keḍәp mandi sakәcapta.

Translation


§12 śaśih, saddhā, taṅ, piṅ, 1, saṅ hyaṅ pisodharī devatanya, bratanya, hayva turu lavan strī, pha, keḍәp aomah-omah.

(1306)
Translation


iya ṅitaṅ kariṅ vulan, kr̥ta masa haranya, den asthiti sira, keṅәtakәna hayva lupa.

(1307)
Translation


3.175

hana brata, saninigraha, ṅa, tan mamati aghni ri kālaniṅ tumpǝk kalivon⟨,⟩ molaha sapuluh tumpәk kalivon, kramanya amuja, ananapuh eṅ saṅgar, amvit anǝmbaha ri bhaṭāra śīvāditya, lviriṅ caru riṅ saṅgar, anapunar, arih, rәmbaṅ, tambo lagu akah araka, phala, kambaṅ vaṅi, burat vaṅi, lәṅa vaṅi, sәḍǝṅan ikṣu, dīpa, dhūpa, den asaṅkǝp, devadarv inasab, vīja, dhūpa, ika kahatur i bhaṭāra, ma, om̐ namo bhagavatye vaśūdevāya, sarvatuṣṭan, dadāsime, om̐ śrī gurubhyo namaḥ, devacarundādasi mahātrәpti svāhā.

(1308)(1309)(1310)

tәlas ta ṅavaṅia ta kita, ma, om̐ sūrya putrāya namaḥ. samaṅkana taṅ brata lәkasakәna, hayva ta pramada riṅ brata, kunaṅ yan kālaṅan agriṅ, sakalviraniṅ aṅalaṅana, pinakavuruṅaniṅ brata, hayva pinakṣakǝn ikaṅ brata, kaliṅanya mvitana juga muvah, kunaṅ yan tan kalaṅana, anulus rahayu, pakṣakәna ika, pha, riṅ dlāhanta dadi ratu sukha vāhya katәmu, pinakāśraya deniṅ paḍanta ratu, keḍәp kapintuhu deniṅ rāt kabeh.

Translation


3.176

iti sāriniṅ brata, kayatnakәna de saṅ amet hayu, ndan ika hayva malәtuh ikaṅ ambǝk, mataṅyan ika hayva mithya buddhi, tātkalanta maṅanakǝn brata, apan yan tan karakṣa ikaṅ brata denta, maṅdadyakǝn vighnaniṅ śarīra, yan enak denta rumakṣa sarīra, makajñāna buddhi mahottama, malilaṅa ahniṅ nirāvaraṇa, tan pagәlәh-gәlәh, tan karakәtan karṇa śūla, mvaṅ rajah tamah, ika ta maṅdadyakǝn svarga magәṅ, ṅuniveh jñāna viśeṣa, vruha ri kramanira sovaṅ-sovaṅ.

(1311)(1312)(1313)(1314)
Translation


3.177

hana brata sabran umanis, ṅa, tan pamaṅan tampakiṅ apuy, rvaṅ vulan samayanya, sabran pahiṅ tan pamaṅan tampakiṅ aghni, rvaṅ vulan samayanya, sabran pon tan padus tan palәṅa, tan pararavup, tan pakәkәmuh, rvaṅ vulan samayanya, sabran vage, tan paturu gumuliṅ, rvaṅ vulan samayanya, sabran kalivon, tan paṅucap-ucap, rvaṅ vulan samayanya, pha, ginañjar deniṅ vatǝk devata kabeh, norana nūkr̥tani, tan hilaṅ takonakәna, drәventa tǝmbe.

(1315)
Translation


3.178

nihan haji pabrata, yaniṅ taṅgal piṅ lima, anuju kalivon, paṅupavāśa,

Translation


§1 esuknya riṅ umanis, amaṅan kupat pāṇḍava, 5, ivaknya kacaṅ, pha, dukiṅ alit duruṅ anәmu, yan vus agәṅ amaṅgih sukha sugih aguṅ dunya.

(1316)
Translation


§2 pa, amaṅan kupat syaṅ anti, 9, ivaknya komak, pha, tinuṅgu deniṅ rāma reṇa, aṅantos aputu abuyut, kinadhama deniṅ bapebu, kapti deniṅ hulun.

(1317)
Translation


§3 pva, amaṅan kupat sidayu, 7, ivaknya sudhaṅ, pha, aṅapti listvayu, alit arampiṅ aṅlәlǝnte, tan amadhani, sukha sugih drәman baṅkit, pinarәkan pinakapahulunaniṅ maru.

Translation


§4 va, amaṅan kupat sih tan pәgat, 4, ivaknya taluh, pha, aṅapti sukha sugih, drәman siddhi baṅkit, keḍәpiṅ alaki, tan kavaśa lakinta aṅluṅani, pinūji deniṅ matva, tanana ṅesǝm.

Translation


§5 ka, anәḍa kupat gәnǝp, 8, ivaknya raraśmen, pha, aṅapti sukha sugih aguṅ vīrya, añjǝnǝṅ arddha nareśvarī, keḍәp aṅucap.

Translation


§6 esuk riṅ umanis, anәḍa kupat siddha luṅguh, 10, ivaknya dagiṅ loh, sāgara dhanu, alas savah, dagiṅ pomahan, ⟨pha,⟩ aṅapti sukha sugih aguṅ vīrya, kinajrihan deniṅ śatru, kinadama deniṅ bala mvaṅ varga, pinarәkan deniṅ bala sabraṅ, tan kevaṅan deniṅ bala, sami vatra tan anaṅsal, siddhi maṇḍi tan paṅucap, rәmrәm ikaṅ vvaṅ kabeh, riṅ panaṅkilan, tinaṅkiliṅ bala sakiṅ doh, abahan təka sakiṅ tan hana, sabran-sabran, yan vadon sinivi deniṅ maru, tan hana maḍani, sadera ṅrehakәna, vr̥ddhi putra, kinajrihan deniṅ santana, vīrya bhukti, embuh mañabuh, imbuh-imbuh tan paṅloṅ. sami danur daha.

(1318)(1319)(1320)
Translation


3.179

hana brata nuṅku rāt, ṅa, kalivon andhūma. umanis, madhuāhāra, pahiṅ, abhāyuāhāra, pvan, atoyāhāra, vage, aghniāhāra, pūrṇama, tīlәm, amatiāhāra, piṅ rvana kabeh, pha, amupusi brata kabeh.

(1321)(1322)(1323)(1324)(1325)(1326)(1327)(1328)(1329)(1330)(1331)(1332)(1333)(1334)(1335)
Translation


3.180

hana brata, mañcavāra, ṅa, umanis amaṅan sәga putih, pahiṅ amaṅan kәtan baṅ, pon amaṅan sәga kuniṅ, vage amaṅan kәtan irәṅ, kalivon amaṅan kәtan amañca varṇa. vetan amaṅan antǝlu putihnya, kidul sura, kulon antǝlu kuniṅ, lor bakakul, riṅ tәṅah śarasi baṅ hati, pha, sukha sugih.

(1336)(1337)(1338)(1339)(1340)(1341)(1342)(1343)(1344)(1345)
Translation


3.181

hana brata, anūt saptavāra, ṅa, ra, asisirih, 5, ra. ca, asisirih, 4, ca. a, asisirih, 3, a. bu, asisirih, 7, bu. vrә, asisirih, 8, vrә. śu, asisirih, 6, śu. śa, asisirih, 9, śa. pha, sukha sugih, vәnaṅ sakāma-kāma.

Translation


3.182

hana brata, amaṅan sәkul slaṅgi sarahup, sinaṅga ri taṅan kiva, tan patәḍa tan patambǝh, tigaṅ vәṅi samayanya, saṅ hyaṅ siddhi rakṣa sira turun abrata, uṅgvanira riṅ rāt, pha, tәḍunaniṅ drәman agave hayu, tan kapәjahan vәka kita, tәrus tumus tәkeṅ vәka vetbet.

(1346)
Translation


3.183

hana brata, maṅan sәkul saravup, sinaṅga ri taṅan kiva, tan patәḍa tan patambǝh, ⟨ivaknya⟩ lalab kevala, 3, vәṅi lavasnya, kārya hana putra, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ sandi rasa sira turun abrata, uṅgvanira riṅ śarīra, riṅ rahasya, ⟨pha,⟩ duk hananiṅ duman agave hayu, kveh putra kveh vvaṅ vәlas asih iri kita.

(1347)
Translation


3.184

hana brata, amaṅan sinaṅga ri taṅan kiva, saivaknya, sagәlǝmiṅ abrata, pakṣa hiḍǝp, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ kuvera hyaṅnya, ya pinakarūpa, pinakakulit, pinakaalis, ⟨pha,⟩ siddhiniṅ vvaṅ abәcik i pambǝkan.

Translation


3.185

hana brata, amaṅan sәkul, pituṅ lek divasanya, pha, akveh mahyun iri kita, anva ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.

Translation


3.186

hana brata, maṅan sәga kevala, sagәlǝmiṅ abrata, hyaṅ puravat sira turun abrata, pha, sucāra vruh ri kaliṅanya.

Translation


3.187

hana brata, amaṅan sәga putih, riṅ taṅgal apisan, saṅ hyaṅ prasiddha turun abrata, satahun samayanya, pha, kinasihaniṅ rāt, ahiliran ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.

(1348)(1349)(1350)(1351)(1352)(1353)(1354)
Translation


3.188

hana brata, amaṅan sәga balaka, sagәlǝmiṅ abrata, saṅ hyaṅ paravan hyaṅnya, pha, vruhiṅ ācarā kaliṅanya.

Translation


3.189

hana brata, amaṅan sәga putih, 5, puluṅ, kәtan baṅ, 5, kәtan jәnar, 5, tridhātu brata, 5, mañcavāra, saṅ hyaṅ padma rasa tumurun abrata, pinakasoca, bāyu śabda iḍǝp, ⟨pha,⟩ sugih tan hina saambǝk phalanya.

(1355)(1356)(1357)(1358)(1359)(1360)(1361)(1362)
Translation


3.190

hana brata, añәkul slaṅgi, ulam pahi, lamanya satәṅah lek, ra nini pāduka bhaṭārī uma hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, avavanon vastu, kinarmakәniṅ akveh.

(1363)(1364)(1365)(1366)(1367)(1368)(1369)
Translation


3.191

hana brata, amaṅan sәkul slaṅgi, anaṅgap, 7, pūr, sira saṅ hyaṅ viśeṣa tumurun abrata, pha, ginañjaran śakti lima, vadon viṣṇu anәmu, tan alәvas tur prajñan, vicakṣaṇa, sukha sugih riṅ dlāha.

(1371)(1372)
Translation


3.192

hana brata, amaṅan sәkul pañcavarṇa, aren tiniṅkah cakra tinañcǝban vr̥ti, denta maṅan maṅkana tatkāla kalivon, añakra bhuvana, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ śivātma sira turun abrata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakayuṣa, pinakalaku, ⟨pha,⟩ dadi vvaṅ aṅuripi jagat, sukha sugih vәnaṅ pinakasāriniṅ jagat, riṅ niṣkala.

Translation


3.193

hana brata jaga varṇa, ṅa, amaṅan sәkul, balañan⟨,⟩ pituṅ vәṅi samayanya, pha, keḍәp deniṅ rāt, prajñan vicakṣaṇa, bisāgamǝl aṅiduṅ, vīryavan.

Translation


3.194

hana brata, yan amaṅan anǝmbah sәkul, pituṅ rātri divasanya, pha, kinasihaniṅ hyaṅ, śrī cittāmaṇi ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.

Translation


3.195

hana brata naṅga sәkul, tinumpaṅan vr̥tti, yan pәjah ikaṅ vr̥ti, pavusan kita pamaṅan, pituṅ vәṅi lavasanya, ⟨pha,⟩ salviriṅ sañjata tan tame kita, aṅañcaṅ ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.

(1373)
Translation


3.196

hana brata, yan amaṅan tinañcǝban vr̥tti vulan, saṅ hyaṅ anuṅkǝbi jagat hyaṅnya, ya pinakarūpa hayu apәkik, ⟨pha,⟩ riṅ dadi vvaṅ sukha sugih, vәnaṅ amatūt jagat riṅ niṣkala.

(1374)
Translation


3.197

hana brata, amaṅan tinañcǝban tuṅgul, tiniṅkah bhīma, hyaṅ maṇik teja, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ paṅirut jagat turun abrata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakalaku, pinakateja, ⟨pha,⟩ aśrī iṅiriṅ sañjata, sakṣat kǝmbaṅ tinuṅgulan, śakti aṅrәbahakǝn jagat riṅ niṣkala.

Translation


3.198

hana brata, avr̥tti, ṅa, yan amaṅan tinañcǝban vr̥tti, pәjah taṅ vr̥tti, avusan amaṅan, saptarātri divasanya, pha, sarvaroga tan tumameṅ śarīranta.

Translation


3.199

hana brata, aṅǝmbaṅ, ṅa, lamun amaṅan kǝmbaṅ rumuhun, tigaṅ tahun tigaṅ lek divasanya, bhaṭāra iśvara hyaṅnya, pha, deva sih iri kita.

Translation


3.200

hana brata, ṅǝmbaṅ, ṅa, tan luṅhā yan kaparan tamu, bhaṭāra viśeṣa maveh brata, pha, sugih tan ilaṅ takonakәna, maṅgәh iṅ deśa norana voṅ siddhi gave.

(1375)(1376)(1377)
Translation


3.201

hana brata aja tukar, ṅa, amaṅan asaṇdiṅ pulava kǝmbaṅ, salek lavasnya, bhaṭāra guru maveh brata, pha, akarma alaki anom, tur kinasihaniṅ paṇḍita.

(1378)
Translation


3.202

hana brata, maṅan kǝmbaṅ naṅkǝṅ umanis, hyaṅ maṇisumila haraniṅ brata, saṅ hyaṅ asmara hyaṅnya, ya pinakarūpa, aśrī sumilah, pasamūhaniṅ akveh riṅ niṣkala.

(1379)(1380)
Translation


3.203

hana brata, yan amaṅan, tinumpaṅan kǝmbaṅ campaka, saṅ hyaṅ maṇik puḍak haraniṅ brata, hyaṅ vidakā turun abrata, ya pinakarūpa, apәkik anulus, ⟨pha,⟩ tumitis iṅ menak, ring dadi vvaṅ, sukha sugih, vicakṣaṇa riṅ niṣkala.

(1381)(1382)
Translation


3.204

hana brata, maṅan lalab luṅluṅan, mvaṅ kinǝmbaṅakǝn, 2, saṅ hyaṅ maṇik arṣana hyaṅnya, bhaṭāra bāyu sira turun abrata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakaurip⟨,⟩, pinakarambut, pinakalǝye, pinakaiḍǝp, pinakagulū, pinakasindhuva, pinakalimbeyan, ⟨pha,⟩ riṅ dadi vvaṅ, sukha sugih, ambǝk ahәniṅ, akǝmbaṅ avoh riṅ niṣkala.

(1383)(1384)
Translation


3.205

hana brata, amaṅan lalab balaka, sambǝl sinamūha, mantra pātāla, ṅa, hyaṅ basuki turun abrata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakālit, pinakadalamakaniṅ suku, pinakatahulan, pinakakәliṅ, ⟨pha,⟩ riṅ dadi vvaṅ, sukha sugih, lәmah sīma, kinapeṅin deniṅ voṅ riṅ niṣkala.

(1385)
Translation


3.206

hana brata, yan amaṅan tinumpaṅan vīja, saṅ hyaṅ vīra kusuma, ṅa, hyaṅ jayaniṅ rāt turun abrata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakajәnǝṅ, pinakapamulu, ⟨pha,⟩ śakti aheṅ rūpanta, riṅ dadi vvaṅ, sukha sugih, rāja drәve, mās pirak, putra putri riṅ niṣkala.

(1386)
Translation


3.207

hana brata, yan amaṅan tinumpaṅan sәkar vaṅi-vaṅi, saṅ hyaṅ mūrva gaṇḍa vaṅi haraniṅ brata, saṅ hyaṅ maṇik sumirit hyaṅniṅ brata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakakulit, pinakāmbə̄, ⟨pha,⟩ riṅ dadi vvaṅ, mrәbuk arūm, anǝrus tәkeṅ kaḍaton riṅ niṣkala.

(1387)
Translation


3.208

hana brata, yan amaṅan sәkar śrīgaḍiṅ, saṅ hyaṅ maṇik śrī danti hyaṅniṅ brata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakagugusi, pinakahuntu, ⟨pha,⟩ aśrī sakeṅ huntunta, sukha sugih, ¿saṅ hyaṅ vidayaka sira turun abrata, pinakarūpa, apәkik anulus, tumitisiṅ menak, prakavi vicakṣaṇa riṅ niṣkala?.

Translation


3.209

hana brata, yan amaṅan alamak sukǝt, puṣpa nismr̥ti, ṅa, bhaṭāra smara hyaṅnya, ya pinakālas, nәhәr ⟨phalanya⟩ kinasihaniṅ bapebu.

Translation


3.210

hana brata, amaṅan alamak pattra, amūrti prāṇa, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ pagər gunuṅ sira turun abrata, ya pinakahuntu, ⟨pha,⟩ dīrgha yuṣa, pәjah tan pahavan kadga.

Translation


3.211

hana brata, ⟨amaṅan⟩ aharyan roṇḍon, pituṅ vulan pituṅ vәṅi divasanya, bhaṭāra mahīśvara hyaṅnya, pha, mulih mariṅ bhaṭāra mahiśvara, sasvarga sira, sasarnya majanma riṅ juru bhāṣa, labdhavāra ri saṅ ahulun.

(1388)
Translation


3.212

hana brata, amaṅan aharyan upih, pinuluṅ kuyupakәna, pha, sugih dodot, mvaṅ siñjaṅ.

(1389)
Translation


3.213

hana brata, ⟨amaṅan⟩ aharyan pampat, kvehnya, 73, aṇḍaniṅ janur, iṅaṅge, pha, sukha sugih, apәkik alus avakta, jarijinta lәmǝs.

(1390)
Translation


3.214

hana brata, sarvagata, ṅa, yan amaṅan tan pahupa, pataṅ lek pataṅ vәṅi samayanya, pha, prajñan vicakṣaṇa, bisa gamәl aṅiduṅ, vāk bajra siddhimantra, jayeṅ śatru keḍәp deniṅ rāt, sukha sugih saṅkan rare.

(1391)
Translation


3.215

hana brata, asiṅ ṅaranya, ¿pisan amaṅan kinaṅ,? yan amaṅan sumәlap aṅinaṅ, nәhәr tan pahupa, salek lavasnya, bhaṭārī uma hyaṅniṅ brata, ma, om̐ yanā devī nama svāhā, ahes, pha, sukha sugih amǝpǝki kaḍaton.

Translation


3.216

hana brata, tan paṅinaṅ, añǝmbuṅ kevala, salek samayanya, saṅ hyaṅ kāma jaya hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, abhrā sumilah miyat kabeh, keḍǝp paṅucapta deniṅ rāt.

(1392)(1393)(1394)(1395)(1396)(1397)(1398)(1399)
Translation


3.217

hana brata, saṅga ṅinaṅ, ṅa, satahun salek lavasnya, pha, drәman malaky arabi, ratu asih, ahes, ma, om̐ bra śrī vastuya nama svāhā.

Translation


3.218

hana brata, asihaniṅ layon, ṅa, aṅinaṅ tan pambuñcal sәpah, tigaṅ tahun samayanya, sahiṅ sәpah kinumpulakǝn, bhinasmi, iki pituturnya, ma, om̐ bhaṭāra mati, ahurip mani amor iṅ megha, tumitis dadi sarvaendah, pinakabhuktiniṅ hulun, sa ba ta a i namā śivāya.

(1400)(1401)(1402)
Translation


3.219

hana brata, aḍahar pucaṅ satәṅah vәlas, ulamaniṅ pahi, ra nini pāduka bhaṭārī anuṅku rāt hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, abәcik kaṅ jariji.

(1403)(1404)
Translation


3.220

hana brata, yan amaṅan asaṇḍiṅ dhūpa damar, saṅ hyaṅ maṇik teja, ṅa, hyaṅ maṇik muntab sira turun abrata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakateja, śakti mahabhāra, ⟨pha,⟩ riṅ dadi vvaṅ, abhrā murub sumilah, aheṅ jәrih kaṅ rāt denta.

Translation


3.221

hana brata, damar aguṅ ṅaranya, tan pamaṅan kasurupan saṅ hyaṅ sūrya, savarṣa lamanya, kaṅ pinaṅan, yuyukan, bavaṅ uṅkul, tarasi, sasivi, raraka malo, caṅkuk sarvan vinuṅkul, prut amuradaṅan, pha, kacakṣu riṅ sarvarusit, luputiṅ sarvaśāstra, tan maṅhel vinuruknya, tumusiṅ aji, aṅlariṅ kevuh, bhaṭāra śiva hyaṅniṅ brata.

(1405)(1406)(1407)(1408)(1409)(1410)(1411)(1412)(1413)(1414)(1415)
Translation


3.222

hana brata, pasaṅ saṇḍe, ṅa, tan pamaṅan kasurupan saṅeṅe, pha, apaḍaṅ kaṅ hati, yan asisinahu eṅgal bisa.

Translation


3.223

hana brata, tan pamaṅan riṅ pūrṇamaniṅ kadaśa, antuk tigaṅ pūrṅamaniṅ kadaśa, pha, svarga sakala katәmu, mañjanma riṅ ratu, paripūrṇānurāga riṅ rāt.

(1416)(1417)(1418)(1419)
Translation


3.224

hana brata, mūrṇama sadā, ṅa, pūrṇama tan pamaṅan tәkaniṅ paṅloṅ apisan, tilǝm tәkaniṅ taṅgal apisan, pha, sugih manәrus, katәkan, sapinakṣanira riṅ bhūmi, saṅ prajuritiṅ bhūmi hyaṅniṅ brata.

(1420)(1421)(1422)(1423)(1424)(1425)(1426)(1427)(1428)(1429)
Translation


3.225

hana brata akasukhan, ṅa, riṅ pūrṇamaniṅ kapitu, piṅ, 7, sarahina, piṅ, 7, savәṅi, amaṅan aṅinum, aṅigǝl, bhaṭāra kapitu maveh brata, pha, sukha sugih, anak amitra, dīrgha yuṣa, keḍәp kapintuhu.

Translation


3.226

hana brata, mәnǝr ri taṅgal, piṅ, 3, maṅan kuñit, mūrṇamasadā, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ trisandhi hyaṅniṅ brata, papalihan bhaṭāra mahādeva, ya pinakarūpa, pinakapamulu, mvaṅ kavicakṣaṇan, ⟨pha,⟩ tan kaluputan.

Translation


taṅgal, piṅ, 4, amaṅan kәtan irәṅ, amuktilabdha, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ cadu śakti hyaṅniṅ brata, papalihan bhaṭāra viṣṇu, ya pinakarūpa, pinakarambut, ⟨pha,⟩ siddhaniṅ ṅvaṅ, anvargakǝn bapebu.

Translation


taṅ, piṅ, 5, […] amañcavāra śakti, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ pañcavāra hyaṅniṅ brata, papalihan bhaṭāra śiva, ya pinakarūpa, pinakaiḍәp, pinakatәṇḍas pha, siddhaniṅ ṅvaṅ sugih tan kaharṣa.

(1430)(1431)(1432)
Translation


3.227

hana brata maṅan raka, pūrṇama tilәm ṅraka, sira saṅ hyaṅ patūt sih tumurun abrata, pha, ginañjaran śakti lima, pinakalalakon sukha sugih tan panambut kārya.

(1433)(1434)(1435)(1436)(1437)
Translation


3.228

hana brata, mūrṇama tilәm, ṅa, maṅupavāsa⟨,⟩ aṅraka kunǝṅ, ⟨pha,⟩ utaṅiṅ atvanta, kәna sinahur polihnya sakarәpta.

Translation


3.229

hana brata, ṅraka naṅkǝn kalivon, patra, ṅa, hyaṅ taruṇa turun abrata, ⟨ya⟩ pinakarūpa, ⟨pha,⟩ siddhaniṅ vaṅ sugih lәmah sīma.

Translation


3.230

hana brata, maṅan sarvaphala, talǝs huvi vahvahan pisaṅ kunaṅ, pituṅ vәṅi lavasnya, kasubhagan kinaharṣan deniṅ strī phalanya, abhoh kayu ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.

(1438)
Translation


3.231

hana brata, maṅan phala gantuṅ, davun sinabraṅ, ṅa, pha, prajurit.

Translation


3.232

hana brata, maṅan sarvabuṅkah, sagәlǝmiṅ abrata, saṅ hyaṅ viśeṣa hyaṅniṅ brata, sukha sugih, puṣṭaka lǝṅǝn phalanya.

Translation


3.233

hana brata, amaṅan sarvaphala, saptarātri lavasnya, pha, kinasihaniṅ strī, yaniṅ strī kinasihaniṅ kakuṅ.

Translation


3.234

hana brata, amaṅan tur ambaṅkit, bhaṭārī keḍәp hyaṅniṅ brata, ṅgonaniṅ amimiti, riṅ pavon, punaṅ kininaṅ sәḍah sapon den tuvuh, lalamak lampuyaṅ, tan pamaṅan tan paṅinaṅ, yan tan paṅgugut lampuyaṅ, pha, vavadon tan pagigilutan, keḍәp malaki.

Translation


3.235

hana brata, amaṅan katambat tigaṅ bulih, naṅkǝn kalivon, tan pamaṅan paran-paran, pituṅ kalivon samayanya, pha, apәkik tur lǝmǝsiṅ rambut.

Translation


3.236

hana brata, ambhūmi lәpa, ṅa, amaṅan jaṅaniṅ lǝlǝpa kabeh, salek lavasnya, bhaṭāra īśvara maveh brata, pha, kinasihaniṅ svami, keḍәp alaki, kinasihaniṅ hyaṅ.

Translation


3.237

hana brata, amaṅana mimba, salek lavasnya, pha, athāravit.

Translation


3.238

hana brata, sarvatatā, ṅa, amaṅan luṅggahiṅ gaṇḍa rusa kәliṅ, mvaṅ campaka garus, bhaṭāra śambhu hyaṅnya, pha, mulih⟨,⟩ riṅ svarga bhaṭāra guru, mvaṅ riṅ bhaṭāra śiva.

(1439)(1440)(1441)
Translation


3.239

hana brata, vījahāra, ṅa, amaṅan vīja rumuhun, saha pucukiṅ gaṇḍa rusa, pucukiṅ alaṅ-alaṅ, pha, prajñan kita, sihaniṅ strī.

(1442)(1443)(1444)(1445)(1446)(1447)(1448)(1449)
Translation


3.240

hana brata, maṅan sarvaluṅgah-luṅgahan, pucukiṅ dukut lәpas, pucukiṅ alaṅ-alaṅ, tuñjuṅ, vīja tәluṅ jumput, saptarātri pituṅ dina lavasanya, siddhakārya saphalanya, amūrva ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.

Translation


3.241

hana brata ṅantavali, ṅa, amaṅan antavali, pañjaṅnya salǝṅkat madhya, pituṅ tumpǝk kalivon patәlasanya, mirica pituṅ viji, ligundi pituṅ muñcuk, pha, salara vighna hilaṅ donya, sojarira keḍәp, […] katәmu maṅke mvaṅ dlāha.

Translation


3.242

hana brata nirambə̄, ṅa, tan pamaṅan sarvainambwan, satahun lavasnya, pha, mulih mariṅ svarga bhaṭāra rudra, sasarnya majanma ri listvayu, apәkik prajurit.

(1450)(1451)
Translation


3.243

hana brata, amaṅan kәtan baṅ pituṅ vәṅi, hirәṅ pituṅ vәṅi, ivaknya sarvaśuci, arariṅ śakti, ṅa, bhagavān paraśara hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, akadaṅ voṅ pәkik.

Translation


3.244

hana brata, amaṅan kәtan taṅkǝp, voṅ tuṅgal tuṅgal riṅ kalivon, 7, hǝmbanya phala, sahaṅ, mәñan, aṅgara kasih amaṅan, 7, alaṇḍeyan, sira saṅ hyaṅ asihiṅ prāṇa turun abrata, ginañjaran śakti lima, pha, sukha sugih, saaptinya vәnaṅ.

(1452)(1453)(1454)(1455)(1456)(1457)(1458)
Translation


3.245

hana brata, anīla, ṅa, amaṅan kәtan hirәṅ, satahun samayanya, pha, mantuk iṅ svarga bhaṭāra viṣṇu, sasarnya majanma riṅ mantrī.

Translation


3.246

hana brata, murāṇa, ṅa, amaṅan ñahñah lan gula tәbu, lamanya tigaṅ dina, pha, tan kataman siṅ saparanta.

Translation


3.247

hana brata, maṅan tan dady akarvan, pituṅ lek lavasnya, sukha magәṅ phalanya, ekapatra ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.

Translation


3.248

hana brata, tan kapaḍan, ṅa, yan amaṅan tan pakǝmbulan, aduluran pañcamuna, sahuripnya riṅ amaṅan, alalab roṇḍon, mvaṅ kǝmbaṅ, uttamaniṅ brata kabeh, pha, tan kapaḍan viśeṣa, maṅkana polahira saṅ viku tәmǝn tәmǝn.

Translation


3.249

hana brata, amaṅan tan pakǝmbulan, pәtaṅ tahun samayanya, pha, mantuk riṅ svarga bhaṭāra rudra, sasarnya mañjanma riṅ kulaputra, kaḍaṅ haji subhaga.

(1459)(1460)(1461)(1462)(1463)(1464)(1465)
Translation


3.250

hana brata, aṅajum, ṅa, amaṅan riṅ vaton⟨,⟩ salek lavasnya, bhaṭāra mahādeva maveh brata, pha, tәka atuduhiṅ paliṅgihan, keḍәp tәka ruruṅeniṅ voṅ.

(1467)
Translation


3.251

hana brata, amutәriṅ paṅkon, ṅa, amaṅan pinaṅku, salek lavasnya, bhaṭāra mahādeva maveh brata, pha, kinasihan deniṅ bapa ibu, malaky arabi, sasarnya dadi bhujaṅga lәvih.

(1468)(1469)(1470)
Translation


3.252

hana brata, amaṅan ry aghūrṇita, pituṅ lek samayanya, pha, siddhimantra, listvayu paripūrṇa.

Translation


3.253

hana brata, naṅkənāra, ṅa, yan amaṅan aṅagǝm jinah, 7, lek samayanya, saṅ hyaṅ rudra hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, akәlar tan kәneṅ griṅ kita.

(1471)(1472)(1473)(1474)(1475)(1476)(1477)
Translation


3.254

hana brata, asaṇḍiṅ jinah keteṅ, salek lavasnya, bhaṭāra indra maveh brata, pha, prajña prakavi, aṣṭa kośala, sasarnya dadi patih sugih.

(1478)(1479)(1480)
Translation


3.255

hana brata, maṅan aṅadut, satahun lavasnya, pha, sugih siddhi mandi, vāk bajra subhaga.

(1481)(1482)(1483)
Translation


3.256

hana brata, amaṅan kupat pāṇḍava, 3, paṅanǝn esuk, 1, paṅanǝn tәṅah ṅve, 1, paṅanǝn sore, 1, pha, rinakṣa deniṅ rāt, kinasavitan deniṅ samanta janma, tan pamuruṅ polihnya.

(1484)(1485)(1486)(1487)(1488)(1489)(1490)(1491)
Translation


3.257

hana brata, maṅan kupat, mevaka sarvaśukla, tәluṅ vәṅi divasanya, bhaṭāra īśvara hyaṅniṅ brata, pha⟨,⟩ bisa ṅiduṅ, abәcikiṅ ulon, manisiṅ panutukan, mvaṅ kinasihaniṅ voṅ.

Translation


3.258

hana brata, aḍahar lәpǝt, lama tәṅah vulan, ra nini kuṇḍaṅ kasih hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, arampiṅ.

Translation


3.259

hana brata, naḍah tumpəṅ, sahasta pañjaṅnya, śūnya ivaknya uyah harәṅ kevala, anarasvatī, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ pitu tan palavan hyaṅniṅ brata, ya pinakaprajña, ⟨pha,⟩ sih malaky arabi, siddhani ṅvaṅ sugih tan surud, mvaṅ pradaṇānuṅku rāt.

Translation


3.260

hana brata, maṅan tumpəṅ, lavasnya tәṅah śaśih, lamun tan kavaśa, pituṅ dina, ra nini paduka bhaṭārī hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, abәcik kaṅ gulū.

Translation


3.261

hana brata, adva savәguṅ, bhaṭāra rudra maveh brata, pha, sugih rumbe.

(1492)(1493)
Translation


3.262

hana brata, asiḍakǝp sarahina, bhaṭāra śaṅkara maveh brata, pha, kinasihaniṅ voṅ.

(1494)
Translation


3.263

hana brata, lumaku savәṅi sarahina, bhaṭāra guru maveh brata, pha, sasarnya dadi deva guru, bahuśiṣya, apәkik rūpa, suteja tiniṅhalan, sugih saṅkan rare, sugih tәrus tumus.

(1495)(1496)(1497)(1498)(1499)(1500)(1501)(1502)
Translation


3.264

hana brata, amәlәṅ tutuk sarahina savәṅi, marәp pūrva, saṅ hyaṅ anәmu jagat sira turun abrata, pha, ginañjaran śakti lima, pinakarāma, pinakalalakon vadon, lituhyu, prajñan, lanaṅ vicakṣaṇa, sukha sugih, maṅke kalavan tǝmbe.

(1503)(1504)(1505)(1506)(1507)(1508)(1509)
Translation


3.265

hana brata ṅālamuñəṅ, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ lәbur jagat sira turun abrata, ginañjaran śakti lima, voṅ tuṅgal sakvehiṅ sira abrata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakalakon, vastu rahayu, lanaṅ vadon sukha sugih drәman keḍәp.

(1510)(1511)(1512)(1513)
Translation


3.266

hana brata, ṅālacakra, ṅa, sira saṅ hyaṅ viśeṣa riṅ bhuvana, sira turun abrata, ginañjaran śakti tigaṅ rakṣa, sakvehaniṅ abrata, pha, sukha sugih, prajñan vicakṣaṇa, lanaṅ vadon.

Translation


3.267

hana brata, mañcavaśa giṇa, ṅa, tan paṅlavaniṅ vadon aṅucap, naṅkǝn umanis, yan vadon tan paṅucapiṅ kakuṅ, tan paṅinaṅ suruhiṅ apvan, lǝlǝmbaran vәnaṅ, pituṅ lek samayanya, pha, tinūtiṅ mās, salviriṅ drәventa tǝmbe.

(1514)
Translation


3.268

hana brata, kukusaniṅ śarīra, ṅa, tan pamaṅan suku pat, lavasnya sakavaśaniṅ abrata, saṅ hyaṅ caduśakti sira turun abrata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakavaṅkoṅ, siddhaniṅ vvaṅ muṣṭika, akveh avәlas, rovaṅ asih iri kita, aṅraṅkus brata.

(1515)(1516)(1517)(1518)(1519)(1520)(1521)
Translation


3.269

hana brata, tan pamaṅan bavi, hyaṅ manasija hyaṅnya, pituṅ tahun samayanya, pha, luputiṅ gәriṅ aguṅ, tur kinasihan deniṅ jagat.

(1522)(1523)(1524)
Translation


3.270

hana brata, tan pamaṅan śr̥gāla, pha, rūpanta tan akusut.

(1525)
Translation


3.271

hana brata, tan pamaṅan ayam, pituṅ lek samayanya, pha, tan pamaṅgih maru.

Translation


3.272

hana brata, tan pamaṅan ayam, satahun samayanya, pha, tan panәmu maru, tur drәman.

(1526)(1527)(1528)
Translation


3.273

hana brata, akәrisa, ṅa, tan pamaṅan yan tan pasisig rumuhun, sari-sari, bhaṭārī śvari hyaṅniṅ brata, satahun sayamanya, pha, prajña, tavitan labdha mās kita.

Translation


3.274

hana brata ñaṇḍiṅ ḍaḍap, lama tigaṅ dina, tan pamaṅan, bhaṭāra śiva hyaṅnya, pha, svarga lәvih dinuṅkapnya, subhaga, ⟨añjanma ri⟩ kulaputra, atәhǝr viśeṣa, bahudaṇḍa ñakravarti.

(1529)(1530)(1531)(1532)(1533)(1534)(1535)
Translation


3.275

hana brata, ṅapitu, ṅa, naṅkǝn dvadaśi śukla pakṣaniṅ kapitu, aṅupavāsa, bhaṭāra bhīma hyaṅnya, ma, om̐ bam̐ bhīmāya namaḥ, pamit, pha, vīryavan kapintuhu deniṅ rāt, sugih mās pirak, hulun putra vr̥ddhi, siddha sakāryanta.

Translation


3.276

hana brata, ṅrәspati, ṅa, kramanya anaṅkǝn vrәspati ṅupavāsa, pha, listuhayu kita, siṅ kāryanta hayu.

(1536)(1537)(1538)(1539)(1540)
Translation


3.277

hana brata, tan pamaṅan pituṅ rātri, pha, vīryavan siddha sakāryanta.

Translation


3.278

hana brata, ṅupavāsa, sacandra samayanya, riṅ kasapuluh, pha, kapituhu deniṅ rāt, mās pirak tәka vr̥ddhi, kinasihan deniṅ paṇḍita.

Translation


3.279

hana brata, yan tәkaniṅ vәton, tan pamaṅan sarvāmbǝkan, pha, antuka omah-omah, tan surud dharmanya, bhaṭāra rudra hyaṅnya.

(1541)(1542)(1543)(1544)(1545)
Translation

There is the observance of ‘thursday’: the manner is one fasts every thursday. Its result is that you will be beautiful, and all your works will be good.


3.280

hana brata tan pamaṅan sarvāmbǝkan, pva, ka, pha, keḍәp deniṅ rāt.

Translation


3.281

hana brata, amiraṅ, ṅa, tan pamaṅan sarvaprāṇa prāṇi, satahun tigaṅ lek samayanya, bhaṭārī pabyavara hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, siṅ prih meṅgal katәmu, deva sih iri kita.

Translation


3.282

hana brata, yan amaṅan asaṇḍiṅ puṣpa liṅga, aṅliga prāṇa, ṅa, hyaṅ aṅgaṣṭi sira turun abrata, pha, keḍәpiṅ rāt, tur rūpanta muntab, śakti prajurit mahābhāra, yan dadi vvaṅ abhrā murub, tan kasoran rūpanta, dīrgha yuṣa paripūrṇa, puruṣa viśeṣa.

(1546)(1547)(1548)(1549)(1550)(1551)(1552)(1553)
Translation


3.283

hana brata, aṅliṅga pәraṅ, ṅa, yan amaṅan asaṇḍiṅ duhuṅ, bhaṭāra rudra hyaṅiṅ brata, pha, akveh vvaṅ tumaṅgalaṅ asih iri kita.

Translation


3.284

hana brata, aṅubi, ṅa, amaṅan aṅinum bañu rumuhun, huvusiṅ amaṅan, tan vәnaṅ aṅucap lavan voṅ, pha, akәlar, sukha sugih, tan kǝna griṅ, tan sasar kapintuhu deniṅ rāt.

Translation


3.285

hana brata, maṅan tan pembuh, tan paṅinum bañu, pha, śakti kiteṅ ri niṣkala, lavasnya sagәlǝmiṅ abrata, saṅ hyaṅ dura dasih hyaṅnya, tatkālaniṅ abrata, tan paturviṅ rahina, ⟨pha,⟩ apaḍaṅ riṅ rūpa, apaḍaṅ kaṅ hati, kinasihaniṅ rāt.

Translation


3.286

hana brata, ñәkul bañu, ⟨ṅa,⟩ tan pamaṅan sәga sadina, tan paturviṅ rahina vәṅi, aṅayapakǝn tәkeṅ polihnya, añjanma hayu, ma, rāga śūnya mahiśi taya, amaṅan sәga satatak, siniratiṅ toya añar, pamit, vus mapamit, maḍahar, sakantunanya, hayva mañapuhaṅ.

Translation


3.287

hana brata ñәkul bañu, mañjiṅ lima ṅaranya, kavaśa amaṅan suruh, maṅan sәkul inumi toya, sәga sakәpǝl tinatak ri lәpa lәpaniṅ taṅan, vәnaṅ inumi bañu sabran sore, lavasiṅ abrata, satahun, yan kavaśa, mokṣa salviriṅ lara, vighnaniṅ śarīra hilaṅ donya.

Translation


3.288

hana brata, tan paṅinum vvai, tatkāla savuku galuṅan, ṅhiṅ tāmaṅan hantiga binәnәm, harәpiṅ ḍәṅǝn, sambi aṅadǝg tәṅah ṅve tatkāla guṅe, ardhana bhaṭāra mr̥tyu, phalanya kәdhuk timbul, tutug tumuvuh, puruṣa viśeṣa, śakti vani, kineriṅan deniṅ jagat, labdhavāra gragaluṅan.

(1554)
Translation


3.289

hana brata, aṅambaṅ, ṅa, yan amaṅan kinambaṅakәn riṅ bañu, satahun samayanya, bhaṭāra viṣṇu maveh brata, pha, mañjanma riṅ kaḍaṅ aji, sugih vәsi, tur keḍәp kavi prajurit.

Translation


3.290

[nyan ta saṅ citta varaṇā, umarah ⟨ri⟩

saṅ vala kula, mūla tattvaniṅ dadi kabeh, pahenak paṅrәṅə̄nta, mūlabhoktaniṅ kanirāśrayan, mvaṅ kābhyudayan, bhāvanya mvaṅ lakṣaṇanya, pūrvanya mvaṅ vәkasnya, maṅkana liṅ saṅ vala kula, nǝmbah hulun, om̐ viku satakvan tānaku, kita pva śikṣā ṅaran ika, duga-duga tumakvan, vuvus maṅkana, rәṅə̄n siptani ṅhulun.

pūrvaṃ śrī puruṣānte, varānugraha makanya, saṅ rojyam, narāsakane, ayavaṃ vidyāṃ prajayaṃ.

maṅkana pariñciniṅ cipta, kaliṅanya, pūrva haraniṅ mimitan, tripuruṣa haraniṅ brahmā viṣṇu īśvara, vara ṅaraniṅ amidhi, anugraha haraniṅ panuṅsuṅ, manoka ṅaraniṅ devata, saroja ṅaraniṅ manūtra, nara ṅaraniṅ mānuṣa, sakāla ṅaraniṅ samaṅke, yaśa ṅaraniṅ kirti, vidyā ṅaraniṅ aji, aprayadha ṅaraniṅ pūjā,

kaliṅanya, bhaṭāra sira magave pratapa riṅ vana giri, maṅaṣkāra bhaṭāra, bhaṭārī, atitah kasukhan amragat trәṣṇa, anusupi vanavāsa, maṅǝnakǝn tapa, manaṅsāra rāga, tinūt deniṅ manūṣa maṅke, atapa abrata, ayoga asamadhī, ayajña dāna kīrti,

maṅhanakǝn brata apayapanya, ulandriya, rumәgǝp pañcendriya, tuṅgalakәna riṅ trisandhyā, piṇdhakǝn riṅ kaparāmarthan, vaḍahana yoga, sahabana samadhi, tindihana brata, tuṅgunǝniṅ dāna kīrti, laṅlaṅana riṅ āgama, pagǝrana pupūjān sasapon, lavaṅana saṅgarma, ugǝr-ugǝrana sadā, inǝbana tuhu, tindihana kañciṅana parāmartha,

yeka ulahaniṅ saṅ tumaki-taki kābhyudayan, kābhyudayan ṅaranya, kavibhavan, kavibhavan ṅaranya, bandha savita, bandha savita ṅaranya, kasugihan kula rūpa, śakti vani, niroga nirvighna, cakṣyah lavajjana, subrata dīrgha yuṣa yovaṇa avet aurip, maṅkana phalaniṅ brata yan inabhyāsa, ya kābhyudayan de saṅ surupa, maṅkana liṅ saṅ citta varaṇa, riṅ saṅ vala kula.

nambah hulun, mapa riṅ kanirāśrayan, mәne pukulun, mәne kami varah iri kita, lakoni siptaṅku riṅ lagi rumuhun, sājña pukulun, vurukәniṅ brata pukulun, pariñcinya, mvaṅ phalanya, a u ma.]


Translation


3.291

hana brata, tan pamaṅan tan paturu, bratanira saṅ hyaṅ vәkasniṅ kavi viśeṣa, pha, svarga lәvih, titisnya añakravarti, subhaga anulus, anurāga riṅ rāt, katәkan sapinakṣanira riṅ bhūmi, dinuluriṅ hayu, śakti vani mahābhāra.

(1555)
Translation


3.292

hana brata, ambhairava pakṣa, siṅ pinaṅan, tuhun tan trәṣṇeṅ turu, bhaṭāra pavakānugrahani, mvaṅ devata, ⟨pha,⟩ bhūta gandharva masih, janmanya puruṣa viśeṣa, subhaga anulus, ajrih kaṅ sarvagalak.

Translation


3.293

hana brata, tan paṅgilani sarvatinaḍah, sambarana, ṅa, pha, vīryavan siddha sugih saṅkan rare.

(1556)(1557)(1558)(1559)(1560)(1561)(1562)(1563)
Translation


3.294

hana brata, ṅarәṅ, ṅa, amaṅan harәṅ rumuhun⟨,⟩ bhaṭārī gaṅga hyaṅniṅ brata, ma, om̐ gaṅgāya namaḥ, salek samayanya, pha, tan kerәṅan deniṅ jagat.

(1564)
Translation


3.295

hana brata, yan amaṅan maivak harәṅ tumpə̄r, pәtaṅ tahun samayanya, pha, keḍәp riṅ samanta janma, kinasihaniṅ rāt, keḍәpiṅ arabi anak-anak.

Translation


3.296

hana brata, maṅan apisan, pituṅ lek pituṅ vәṅi samayanya, pha, kinasihaniṅ rāt.

Translation


3.297

hana brata nitīkrama, ṅa, amaṅan sadina sapisan, saṅ hyaṅ smara hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, siṅ prih meṅgal katәmu, dīrgha yuṣa.

(1565)(1566)(1567)(1568)
Translation


3.298

nahan brata, maṅan piṅ sapta, pituṅ lek samayanya, kinasihaniṅ rāt phalanya.

(1569)
Translation


3.299

hana brata, ambhūmi amasar bhuvana, ṅa, pha, sugih lәmah sīma.

Translation


3.300

hana brata, maṅan iṅ lәmah, pituṅ śaśih lavasnya, kinasihaniṅ rāt phalanya, bhūmi ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.

Translation


3.301

hana brata, mañcavāra, ṅa, u, marәp maṅetan amaṅan, pa, marәp kidul amaṅan. pva, marәp aṅulon. va, marәp aṅalor amaṅan. ka, siṅ harәpira maṅan, duluranya lalab kabeh, mvaṅ kǝmbaṅ anūt kadi varṇaniṅ sәga, pañcavarṇa, putih kuniṅ abaṅ irәṅ, riṅ teṅah pañcavarṇa, deva rata hyaṅnya, pha, mantuk iṅ svarga pada bhaṭāra śiva, sasarnya mañjanma ratu cakravarti, tan kapaḍan. ma, om̐ om̐ śrī jagat guru padukebhyo namaḥ, pamit.

(1570)(1571)(1572)
Translation


3.302

hana brata, mañcavāra dalәm, ṅa, kramanya, amaṅan uyah kevala, amaṅan sәkul kevala, salek tәluṅ dina samayanya, vus maṅkana, ulam kevala, vus maṅkana, toya kevala, vus maṅkana, aṅinaṅ kevala, vus maṅkana lavasnya, kәneṅ paṅan, tan kәneṅ turu, samaṅkana lavasnya, saṅ hyaṅ vәkasiṅ anuṅku rāt hyaṅnya ikaṅ brata, tan upir-upir sukhanta, mantuk riṅ svargan bhaṭāra dharma, janmanya sukha maṅan aṅaṅgur, tan aṅhel panambut gave, sukha sugih tan pasaṅkan, kaṅ vvaṅ masih deva bikṣuka, mulih iri kita.

(1573)
Translation


3.303

hana brata, luhuriṅ kayu, ṅa, tigaṅ lek samayanya, pha, vr̥ddhi putra, tur keḍәp siṅ paṅucap.

(1574)(1575)(1576)
Translation


3.304

hana brata, aturu luhuriṅ kayu, salek divasanya, pha, śakti kasiddhyan kapaṅguh.

Translation


3.305

hana brata, aṅalasa, ṅa, asaṅidan iṅ alas savәguṅ, tan papasa deniṅ voṅ, ṅuniveh sarvasato, asǝp, pha, prajurit riṅ paravu, aṅuṅgahana bahanya, ve, harәṅ prajurit riṅ ḍarat lugutana vatu, saṅ buddha asuṅ brata, sasarnya dadi dam puhavaṅ riṅ parahu, sugih savah, tur sugih parahu.

(1577)(1578)(1579)(1580)(1581)(1582)(1583)(1584)(1585)(1586)(1587)(1588)(1589)(1590)(1591)(1592)
Translation


3.306

hana brata, ṅraka sabran tilәm mvaṅ pūrṇama, sarvaputus, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ silih asih maveh brata, pha, tinuṅgviṅ rāma rena, sukha sugih prih avak, tur tan paṅubiṅ voṅ atuha.

Translation


3.307

hana brata, maṅan gǝḍaṅ tan kinulitan, tәluṅ vәṅi samayanya, saṅ hyaṅ murṣita hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, apәkik, yen strī mǝṅgǝpiṅ pahyunan, abәcikiṅ buddhi, vruhiṅ kaliṅanya, pituturiṅ bapebu.

(1593)
Translation


3.308

hana brata, maṅan tuhuṅ pitpit rumuhun, saṅ hyaṅ maṇik muñcar, ṅaraniṅ brata, saṅ hyaṅ maṇik aṅuñci pǝpǝt sira turun abrata, pinakabhaga, pinakarūpa, paṅadǝganiṅ vavadon, pinakalituhayu, ⟨pha,⟩ drәman manis ta kita, lindihǝn voṅ apәkik, drәman anak anak, aputu riṅ niṣkala.

(1594)
Translation


3.309

hana brata, milir kacaṅ, ṅa, kramanya, aṅupavāsa savәguṅ, amaṅan savәguṅ, hyaṅ prajā sadā hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, mantuk riṅ svargan bhaṭāra iśvara, sasarnya mañjanma sukha sugih, lәvih anulus, yan lanaṅ puruṣa kula pratyakṣa anurāga kita, sugih pisis riṅ dlāha, yan strī samaṅkana.

(1595)(1596)(1597)(1598)(1599)(1600)(1601)(1602)(1603)
Translation


3.310

hana brata, yan amaṅan sinaren kasumba, saṅ hyaṅ maṇik pari rāja, ṅa, hyaṅ maṇik teja bhūmi turun abrata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakarah-dagiṅ, pinakahati, ⟨pha,⟩ riṅ dadi vvaṅ, sukha sugih, lituhayu, sәkar tan alum, akǝmbaṅ avoh riṅ niṣkala.

(1604)
Translation


3.311

hana brata, maṅan sәkul sapuluṅ, saṅ hyaṅ maṇik tampa, ṅaraniṅ brata, saṅ hyaṅ maṇḍala hyaṅniṅ brata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakakukusaniṅ śarīra, ⟨pha,⟩ asǝsǝkan kanaka aguṅ, kalavan alit, aśrī asambaṅ jarijya, siddhaniṅ vvaṅ sukha sugih, tan pәgat sādhana, mvaṅ mās maṇik, kinaṇṭi jagat kinaṇṭi japa kita riṅ dlāha.

Translation


3.312

hana brata, maṅan sәkul putih kuniṅ, aṅkǝn kalivon, umarәp pūrva, mevaka bhīra, paṅan pisan saṅaṅ kalivon divasanya, uttama saṅaṅ vulan, bhaṭāra śiva hyaṅniṅ brata, papalihan hyaṅ antadeva, ya pinakarūpa, pinakasamūha, pinakadīrgha yuṣa, yan lanaṅ pinakapәkikan, pinakapolah, pinakararas, yan vadon pinakakahayon pinakapolah, pinakaibon, pha, mulihiṅ svarga bhaṭāra śiva, sasarnya mañjanma riṅ prabhu añakravarti viku, bhujaṅga, śeva sogata, sugih malǝṅkәr riṅ mās pirak, sarvasosoca, rare, hulun, kәbo sapi, mr̥gādi, vr̥ddhi putra, tinuṅgviṅ bapebu, kaki nini, ma, om̐ hram̐ hrim̐ sah paramaśivādityāya namaḥ, ahyas.

(1605)
Translation


3.313

hana brata, amiśeṣa, ṅa, yan amaṅan tan pahupa, anәlasana sәkul, yan vus kinurәn-kurәn, ma, atma tuturakәna mariṅ bhaṭāra viśeṣa, umuṅguh riṅ vindu nādha, sakala niṣkala, viśeṣa bhaṭāra baja, maty aturu, maty aluṅguh, maty aṅadǝg, lәsa alәyǝp, pavak tan paśarīra sakala niṣkala.

(1606)(1607)(1608)(1609)(1610)(1611)(1612)
Translation


3.314

hana brata, nūtakǝn saśila bhaṭāra gaṇa, amuṣpa gaṇa, ṅa, yan amaṅan sәga nǝm kǝpǝl, sarahina, tiṅkahiṅ amaṅan, śīla gaṇa, nǝm vulan samayanya, pha, mantuk iṅ bhaṭāra guru, sasarnya mañjanma riṅ viku ijo, śakti dūradarśana, sojarira keḍǝp.

(1613)
Translation


3.315

hana brata, maṅan sәga sinaṅga ri taṅan kiva, tan patәḍa⟨,⟩ tan patambǝh, tan apilih ivaknya, apadmayoni, ṅa, hyaṅ siddhi narasiṅha turun abrata, ya pinakarūpa, pinakalaku, ⟨pha,⟩ siddhaniṅ vaṅ anambaddhani śabda, sihniṅ rāt, ma, om̐ om̐ siddhi kāraṇāya namaḥ svāhā, yan ahyas.

(1614)
Translation


3.316

hana brata, jaṅga varṇa, ṅa, amaṅan sәga balaka, pituṅ dina lavasnya mabhyāsa, pha, keḍәp savuvusta deniṅ rāt, prajñan vicakṣaṇa, biṣa gamǝl aṅiduṅ.

Translation


3.317

hana brata, jaga śatru, ṅa, saṅ hyaṅ saptanala hyaṅniṅ brata, kramanya, taṅgal pisan piṅ ro tәmu taṅgal piṅ pitu, lamun huvus sumurup vulan juga kita vәnaṅ aturu, livat saṅkeṅ taṅgal piṅ pitu, sakarәptāturu, maṅkaneṅ krәṣṇa pakṣa, lamun mәtu vulan juga kita turu, livat saṅke rika, sakarәpta turu, pha, riṅ dadi vvaṅ sugih, tan hana nuskr̥ta, riṅ niṣkala.

Translation


3.318

hana brata, mārab, ṅa, maṅlәkasa taṅgal iṅ kapat mabrata, maṅana purāṇa, kǝmbaṅ nāgasāri, kulalaṭa, malabahan iṅ pūrṇama, polihnyāpәkik hayu tan pasiriṅ, ma, om̐ smarāya namaḥ, yan ahyas.

(1615)
Translation

There is the observance of ‘Being Glow’ (Mārab) ↓37 : one should start performing the observance on the fourth day of the waxing moon. One should eat the flower of nāgasāri (Mesua ferrea), pūraṇa (Clitoria ternatea) ↓38, [and] kulalaṭa ↓39. It should end on the full moon. Its result is being handsome [or] beautiful without equal. The mantra is: ’Oṃ hail to Smara! [It is recited] when applying make-up.

Notes
↑37. I have conjectured the word mūrāba as mārab, as the former does not appear in the OJED or Balinese dictionaries. I assume that mūraba is a mystical form of mārab, which means ‘to flare, flame, blaze, glow’ (OJED, s.v.). It is also consistent with the technique of performing the observance, whereby the practitioner eats certain types of flowers.
↑38. Nāgasāri: According to the text titled Kavi Jānaki, collected in Unit Lontar, Udayana University. I found the word purāṇa used to designate one plant, namely itil. The text contains: krĕntikā, smaracatrā, wagaprańā, puranā, gamantya ṅa itil (Kavi Jānaki, 16r). In the oral tradition, the word itil refers to the talaṅ flower (Clitoria ternatea).
↑39. I have not found the specific plant to which kulalaṭa refers. OJED (s.v.) explains that lalaṭa is a particular kind of flower or floral motif.

3.319

hana brata, taṅgal piṅ savlas, atikukus, ṅa, phalanya vīrya, drәman anulus.

(1616)(1617)(1618)
Translation

There is the observance↓40 [perfomed] on the eleventh day of the waxing moon. It is called ‘beyond the smoke’ (Atikukus). Its result is becoming a brave man, [and] being perfectly prosperous.

Notes
↑40. This passage does not provide a detailed explanation of the technique for performing the observance. I assume that the word mopavāsa ‘fasting’ is needed here to complete the explanation. The word brata itself also has the meaning of a ‘holy practice’ (fasting, continence, etc.) (OJED, s.v.).

3.320

hana brata, maṅan aron-aron, ulam kalapa binakar, lima vәlas dina divasanya, saṅ hyaṅ viśeṣa hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, abәcik kaṅ hulon.

(1619)(1620)(1621)(1622)(1623)
Translation

There is the observance of eating half cooked-rice ↓41, [and] burning coconuts. Its appointed duration is fifteen days. The deity of the observance is the Reverend Viśeṣa. Its result is a beautiful head.

Notes
↑41. I translate aron-aron as ‘half-cooked rice’ rather than ‘with leaves’ (variant form of aron-ron). I assume the word aron-aron was derived from the words haru or aru. In Old Javanese, haru-daṅ means ‘a pot for half-cooked rice’ and paṅarvan means ‘a pot in which half-cooked rice is stirred before being put back in the kukusan’ (ModJ) (OJED, s.v.). In Balinese, the words haru/aru + -an become aruwan/aron (another instance for this sound change is: kalaṅvan → kalaṅon/kalaṅәn, vvaṅ → voṅ, etc. ), meaning ‘half-cooked rice’.

3.321

hana brata, amaṅan tan paron, pituṅ lek divasanya, pha, siddhakārya, jayapattra ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.

(1624)(1625)(1626)(1627)(1628)
Translation

There is the observance of eating without using a leaf [as a plate]. Its appointed duration is seven months. Its result is that one’s actions are successful. The name of such observance is ‘Record of Victory’ (Jayapattra) ↓42.

Notes
↑42. OJED (s.v.) defines the term jayapattra as ‘a record of victory (in a lawsuit) given to the victorious party’. In this context, I only use ‘record of victory’ to make the translation jayapattra more precise.

3.322

hana brata, ṅavaśakәn sakvehiṅ brata, pha, mantuk iṅ svarga bhaṭāra umapati, ⟨sasarnya⟩ añjanma prabhu añakravarti, viku śakti bahusikṣa, labdhavāra subhaga.

(1629)
Translation

There is an observance that over powers all [other] observances. Its result is reaching the heaven of the Lord Umapati. [Alternatively, if] something goes wrong one will reborn as a world ruler; being a powerful priest who has many disciples; having received fame as a gift.


3.323

hana brata, kadi rare, tan kinatәṅǝtakәn, pha, tan pavali-valy añjanma kita, sasarnya dadi ratu.

Translation

There is the observance of being like a child who will not keep a secret. Its result is that you are not reincarnated repeatedly. [Alternatively, if] something goes wrong, one is reborn as a king.


3.324

nihan brata, amati aghni, asisirih, 3, dina, tan pamaṅan sakalvirnya, tutug 3, dina, alabahan, tur tīrthanana, pha, hilaṅ pāpa kleśaniṅ śarīra.

Translation

There is the observance of putting out the fire, chewing betel for three days, [and] not eating all kinds [of food]. It is finished after three days↓43, and should be sprinkled with holy water. Its result is that all of one’s pain vanishes.

Notes
↑43. Other alternatives for this translation is ‘the food is taken after abstinence for three days’.

3.325

hana brata, amaṅan sǝsǝḍǝp rumuhun, pituṅ tahun divasanya, bhaṭārī vastu hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, keḍәpiṅ rāt.

Translation

There is the observance of consuming sәsәḍĕp↓44 before the other. Its appointed duration is seven years. The deity of the observance is the Goddess Vastu. Its result is being obeyed by mankind.

Notes
↑44. Sәsәḍep is finely chopped betel etc with dadap leaves, bras and kuñit used as bhasma on the temples, between the eyes, on the head and the shoulder-blades (esp. in certain ceremonies) (OJED s.v.)

3.326

hana brata, maṅan mevak uyah harәṅ, pha, keḍәp riṅ rāt, kineriṅan deniṅ bhuvana, kinajrihan deniṅ śatru.

(1630)
Translation

There is the observance of eating the salt mix with charcoal as meat. Its result is being obeyed by mankind, being followed by the world, [and] being feared by enemies.


3.327

hana brata, mamaṅan caturvarṇa, limaṅ vәṅi lavasanya, prajña śakti phalanika, tәhǝr kinasihaniṅ rāt, apūrva kita, sakabdhu ṅaraniṅ brata maṅkana.

Translation

There is the observance of eating the [cooked rice] with four colours. Its appointed duration is five nights. Its result is becoming smart [and] powerful, and then being loved by mankind. You [will become] prominent. The name of such observance is sakabdhu ↓45

Notes
↑45. The word sakabdhu does not exist in OJED and Balinese dictionaries. I have not found any interpretations of this word yet.

3.328

hana brata maṅan rahina, 5, tәluṅ lek lavasnya, pha, halus jarijinta, mvaṅ romanta.

(1631)(1632)(1633)(1634)
Translation

There is the observance of eating during the day, five [times] ↓46. Its result is that your fingers and skin will be fine.

Notes
↑46. The number 5 in the text is not clearly explained. For the time being, this number 5 is interpreted as ‘5 times’. I put it in the brackets. Another possibility is ‘5 handfuls of food per day’.

3.329

hana brata, ṅantara, ṅa, maṅan tәṅah ṅve, tәṅah vәṅi, tigaṅ lek lavasnya mabhyāsa, pha, śakti saturasta, sukha magə̄ṅ.

Translation

There is the observance of ‘Following Interval’ (Ṅantāra): one eats in the middle of the day, [and] in the middle of the night. Its appointed duration for repeated exercise is three months. Its result is that all your descendants become powerful, [and experience] great happiness.


3.330

hana brata, maṅan pituṅ kәpǝl, sadina, pituṅ rahina samayanya, mabrata, catur ṅaraniṅ brata, ⟨pha,⟩ riṅ dadi vvaṅ sarvavәsi tan tumamahi śarīranta, riṅ niṣkala.

Translation

There is the observance of eating seven handfuls [of food] in one day. Its appointed duration to perform the observance is seven days. The name of the observance is four (Catur) ↓47. Its result↓48 is that you will be reborn as a person with a body unaffected by any type of iron in the invisible realm.

Notes
↑47. I have not found yet the releation between the name of this observance catur ‘four’ with the technique to perform the observance and the duration.
↑48. For the reason in adding the word pha, in this passage see footnote 3.331.

3.331

hana brata, yan amaṅan tan paluṅguh, saṅ hyaṅ hayu maveh brata, saṅ hyaṅ laku-laku haraniṅ brata, ya pinakarūpa hayu raspati, ⟨pha,⟩ sukha riṅ lakunta, lәbur tampakta aśrī iṅiriṅan, deniṅ pavoṅan, siddhaniṅ vvaṅ sukha sugih, amukti sāriniṅ kaḍaton, kita riṅ dlāha.

Translation

There is the observance of eating without sitting. The Reverend Hayu gives the observance. The name of the observance is the Reverend of Walking (Saṅ Hyaṅ Laku). He serves as an appearance who is beautifully attractive. Its result ↓49 is being happy in your journey; the ash of your trace is followed by attendants; you will be successful with happiness and wealth; you will enjoy the palace in the future.

Notes
↑49. I have added the word pha, meaning ‘its result’ in accordance with the general pattern found in other passages of the Tattva Brata. Pha is typically placed after the mantra portion: ma, om̐ śambhave namaḥ, pamit, pha, mañjanma riṅ kulaputra (3.26); after the duration of the brata: tigaṅ tahun lavasnya, pha, drәman aputra, siṅ prih meṅgal katəkan (3.27); after the technical details of the brata’s performance: hana brata tan pamaṅan ivak bavi, pha, tan kataman deniṅ sarvaviṣya (3.63), after the name of the brata: saṅ hyaṅ kr̥ta bhuvana hyaṅniṅ brata, pha, etc. (3.87).

3.332

hana brata, amaṇḍapa, ṅa, amaṅan riṅ paṅkon, malamak patra, saṅ hyaṅ sūkṣma maveh brata, phalanya sapolahta pantǝs, tan pәgat sihniṅ malaky arabi, salek samayanya, ma, om̐ sūkṣmāya namaḥ, pamit.

(1635)
Translation

There is the observance of ‘Behaving like Open Hall’ (Maṇḍapa): one eats in the lap using the leaves as a base. The Reverend Sūkṣma gives the observance. Its result is that all your deeds are fit (completely right), [and] your relationship with your spouse is not cut off. Its appointed duration is one month. The mantra is: “Om̐ hail to the [Reverend] Sūkṣma!” [I take] leave.


3.333

hana brata, tan pamaṅan sarvāmbǝkan, naṅkǝn pon, mvaṅ kalivon, pha, keḍәpiṅ rāt.

Translation

There is the observance of not eating all kinds of breathing beings every Pon ↓50 and Kalivon ↓51day. Its result is being obeyed by mankind.

Notes
↑50. Pon is the third day in the five-day cycle (pañcavāra) of the Old Javanese/Balinese calendar system.
↑51. Kalivon is the fifth day in the five-day cycle (pañcavāra) of the Old Javanese/Balinese calendar system.

3.334

hana brata, yan amaṅan aṅilo riṅ pahesan, naṅkǝn pūrṇama, satahun divasanya, pha, mañjanma riṅ kabayan buyut sugih.

Translation

There is the observance of eating while looking in the mirror every full moon day. Its appointed duration is one year. Its result is being reborn as a rich senior customary village head (kabayan buyut) ↓52.

Notes
↑52. The word kabayan means ‘old; an elder, chief, leader’ (OJED, s.v.), while buyut means ‘great-grandfather, great-grandchild; elder’ (OJED, s.v.). In the Balinese context, the word kabayan refers to a ‘customary village head’ (KBI, 2016: 96). For this reason, in this context, I translate kabayan buyut as ‘senior customary village head’.

3.335

nihan aji rambut, amaṅan sәga hirәṅ, naṅkǝn caturthi, śukla pakṣa, ma, hulun aṅaji rambut, tan abaṅ, tan hana raṅraṅ, tan hana putih, sәlǝm abuluniṅ gagak, adavā, alәmәs, atәtәl, kon rambutin hulun, katәmu maṅko, lәvih kaṅ tǝmbe hulun aṅaji rambut, vastu hulun aṅaji rambut, om̐ sa ba ta a i namā śivāya.

(1636)(1637)
Translation

This is the sacred text on the hair (Aji Rambut): one eats the black cooked rice every fourth day of the bright half of the lunar month. The mantra is: “I am performing the sacred teaching of the hair that is not red, not transparent, not white. May my hair be black just like a crow: long, soft ↓53, [and] thick. It is obtained presently. I am performing the sacred teaching of hair, which is good presently. Surely, I am performing the sacred teaching of hair. Om̐ Sa Ba Ta A I! Hail to Śiva!”

Notes
↑53. I have emended the word alambas to alәmәs. The Balinese word alambas meaning ‘long’ (KBI, 2016: 540) is already expressed by the word adavā ‘long’ (OJED, s.v.) in the previous word in this sentence. The word alәmәs meaning ‘pliant, lithe, lissom, supple, slender, and soft’ (OJED, s.v.) is a more suitable choice in this context as the main topic is about the hair.

3.336

hana brata, mona mūjā, pha, deva masih iri kita.

Translation

There is the observance of being silent in worship. Its result is that you will be loved by God.


3.337

hana brata, mona, ṅa, yan aṅisiṅ, yan ahuyuh, yan adyus, yan alәlәṅa, yan abasahan, yan lumaku, pituṅ lek samayanya, bhaṭāra śiva maveh brata, sasarnya sugih duve, sugih vәka, tur keḍәp, mañjanma riṅ mantrī.

Translation

There is the observance of being silent when defecating, urinating, taking a bath, applying oil, wearing undergarments, [and] walking. Its appointed duration is seven months. Lord Śiva gives the observance. [Alternatively, if] something goes wrong, one will be rich in property, rich in offspring, and be obeyed [by people], [as well as] being reborn as a minister.


i śaka, 1722. vai, ka, vrә, vāra marakih, pratipāda riṅ śukla pakṣa, asuji maśa, rah, 2, tǝṅgǝk, 2. i rika divasanya, pūrṇa linikhita.

(1638)
Translation

In 1722 Śaka (1800 AD), on Thursday Kalivon, Vāra Marakih↓54, on the first day of the bright lunar fortnight in the month Asuji (September-October). The unit is two. The tens are two. That is the time when it is completely written.↓55

Notes
↑54. Marakih is the name of the 16th vuku (OJED, s.v.)
↑55. This manuscript was completed at the end of the 18th century.

^326. ] G M N P U • hana brata yan amaṅan anūtakǝn vulan ... śiṣya təka; in P the title of the brata, mantra, and result is same with other witnesses, but tend to different in the technique to perform the observance. "hana brata hañutakәn hulan·, yan amaṅan taṅgal hapisan·, sakәpәl·, taṅ, 2, rvaṅ kәpәl·, muṅgah sakәpәl· sadinā, tәkāniṅ taṅgal·, piṅ, 14, pūrnama hamr̥ti, yan paṅloṅ hapisan·, piṅ, 14, sinuddhana sakәpәl·, tәkaniṅ til̥m hamr̥ti, tigaṅ lek· ṣamayanya, bhaṭārendra hyaṅnya, ma, Ōm̐ surendra ya namaḥ, pamit·. phalanya mantukiṅ bhaṭāra śivā, sasarnya mañjanmā riṅ ratu, mvaṅ riṅ vikva bhavu siṣyā kitā." G U in 3.26 M N P in 3.29
